0.3.11\n\n- Various improvements to the `mitmproxy-macos` source distribution.\n\n## 0.3.8\n\n- `mitmproxy-macos` is now also distributed as a source distribution on PyPI.\n  The source distribution contains some pre-compiled binaries built by our CI.\n  This is necessary because the network system extension needs to be signed &\n  notarized with a valid Apple Developer ID before it can be installed.\n\n## 0.3.7\n\n- Raise an ImportError if platform-specific dependencies are missing.\n\n## 0.3.6\n\n- Building from source does not require a protobuf compiler anymore.\n\n## 0.3.1 - 0.3.5\n\n- Improve transparent proxy functionality on macOS.\n\n## 0.3.0","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da4e9260-2259-45b0-b397-1ebc6cd07ed7","uuid":"fb0b3a10-95ae-469f-9640-d0227b8892e7","timestamp":"2026-07-02T06:58:47.622Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"## 0.5.1\n\n- Dependency updates.\n\n## 0.5.1\n\n- Make server shutdown more robust.\n\n## 0.5.0\n\n- UDP connections are now modeled as streams.\n\n## 0.4.0\n\n- Renamed `OsProxy` to `LocalRedirector`.\n\n## 0.3.9 - 0.3.11\n\n- Various improvements to the `mitmproxy-macos` source distribution.\n\n## 0.3.8\n\n- `mitmproxy-macos` is now also distributed as a source distribution on PyPI.\n  The source distribution contains some pre-compiled binaries built by our CI.\n  This is necessary because the network system extension needs to be signed &\n  notarized with a valid Apple Developer ID before it can be installed.\n\n## 0.3.7\n\n- Raise an ImportError if platform-specific dependencies are missing.\n\n## 0.3.6\n\n- Building from source does not require a protobuf compiler anymore.\n\n## 0.3.1 - 0.3.5\n\n- Improve transparent proxy functionality on macOS.\n\n## 0.3.0","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false}}

lo=key(base)\n    hi=caret_max(base)\n    return tuple(kv[:3]+[0]*(3-len(kv)))>=tuple(lo[:3]+[0]*(3-len(lo))) and tuple(kv[:3]+[0]*(3-len(kv)))<hi\ndef latest_inrange(c,base):\n    req=urllib.request.Request(f\"https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/{c}/versions\",headers={'User-Agent':'dc'})\n    d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=25))\n    best=None\n    for v in d['versions']:\n        n=v['num']\n        if v.get('yanked'): continue\n        if v['created_at']>cutoff+'T23:59:59Z': continue\n        if any(x in n for x in ('alpha','beta','-rc','-pre','pre.')): continue\n        if not in_range(n,base): continue\n        if best is None or key(n)>key(best): best=n\n    return best\nseen=set()\nfor c,locked,base in deps:\n    if c in seen: continue\n    seen.add(c)\n    li=latest_inrange(c,base)\n    mark=''\n    try:\n        if li and key(li)>key(locked): mark=f'  <== LOCK BUMP {locked}->{li}'\n    except: pass\n    print(f\"{c:26} locked={locked:10} manifestbase={base:8} latest_inrange@{cutoff}={li}{mark}\")\nPY","description":"Compute in-range lock bumps as of 2024-05-02"},"name":"Bash","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_01USZtdt1Yj5a8AwFBAZpPnp","model":"claude-opus-4-8","role":"assistant","stop_details":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":870},"cache_creation_input_tokens":870,"cache_read_input_tokens":60751,"inference_geo":"global","input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da4e9260-2259-45b0-b397-1ebc6cd07ed7","uuid":"f4b840df-55e7-432c-bfdf-e55f11b1ecd2"}
